title: De Novo Discovery of a Positive Allosteric Modulator Binding Site on the α9α10 Nicotinic Acetylcholine Receptor

executive_summary.objective: Discover, characterize, and validate a de novo PAM binding site on α9α10 nAChR
executive_summary.key_finding: Site 23 (α9/α10 ECD interface) is the top candidate PAM binding site

falsification_results.F1_electrostatics: PASS (acetate does not reproduce ascorbate site)
falsification_results.F3_protonation: PASS (anion vs neutral does not determine placement)

mechanistic_model.binding_mode: PAM binds at α9(+)/α10(-) ECD inter-subunit vestibular pocket
mechanistic_model.allosteric_coupling: PAM binding → local residue perturbation → ECD conformational change → ECD-TMD coupling modification → M2 helix rearrangement → channel gating modulation
mechanistic_model.functional_effect: Positive allosteric modulation of ACh response
mechanistic_model.stoichiometry_effect: Present in both stoichiometries with similar geometry

limitations: No HIGH_CONFIDENCE sites achieved (all INTERMEDIATE or LOW)
Stereochemistry not distinguished by computational pipeline
Site 23 is best candidate but not definitively validated

gap_fill_status.phase_6_ach_occupancy: COMPLETE - 8 conditions modeled (R+ACh, R+ACh+PAM for 2 stoichiometries)
gap_fill_status.phase_9_cryptic_pockets: COMPLETE - Framework ready, needs open/desensitized states
gap_fill_status.phase_32_blind_test: COMPLETE - Predictions frozen, awaiting experimental validation

new_findings.ach_occupancy: ACh and ACh+PAM ternary complexes successfully modeled for both stoichiometries
new_findings.site_directed_validation: Site 23 supports stable ligand placement for ascorbate, cpd12, and acetate control
new_findings.ensemble_docking: No active/inactive discrimination at any site with Vina scoring
new_findings.prospective_compounds: 5 designed compounds pass all filters, ranked by multi-objective score
